01440 Gid`om {gid-o:m'}

源自 01438; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Gidom 1; 1

基頓 = "砍下"
1) 一處位於基比亞和臨門磐岩中間的地方, 以色列人追殺便雅憫人至此方休
   (#士 20:45|)
record.edic_text:
01440 Gid`om {ghid-ohm'}

from 01438;; n pr loc

AV - Gidom 1; 1

Gidom = "a cutting down"
1) the place where the Israelites ceased pursuing Benjamin, apparently
   situated between Gibeah and the cliffs of Rimmon
